Descriptions.ShortDescription: Advanced PHD2 guiding log analyzer for N.I.N.A.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
GuidingAnalyzer is a comprehensive PHD2 guiding log analysis plugin for N.I.N.A.

Features:
• PHD2 / DEC curves with interactive crosshair and zoom
• FFT spectrum analysis (drift-corrected and uncorrected modes) to identify periodic error, backlash and vibrations
• Worm gear period estimation with confidence scoring
• Multi-session comparison with overlaid FFT spectra
• Polar alignment error estimation from drift (Az/Alt in arcmin, screw turns)
• RMS vs Altitude scatter plot and sliding RMS trend over a full night
• Advanced statistics: skewness, kurtosis, RA/DEC correlation, stability ratio
• Automatic anomaly detection (PE, backlash, flexure, poor guide star…)
• Prioritized advice list with recommended actions
• Full session metadata display (equipment, algorithms, calibration)
• CSV and JSON export
